entries.condition: If the core itself leaks or is clogged,

existingFixParts.note: OEM Mopar all-aluminum core for the WK2 generation (2011-2021 Grand Cherokee; also fits 2011-2021 Dodge Durango WD). Superseded from earlier 1563697. This is the primary dash-out replacement part when the core itself leaks or is clogged. Use ONLY for 2011-2021 — do not fit to a 2005-2010 WK.
existingFixParts.component: Heater core (2011-2021 WK2)

existingFixParts.note: OEM Mopar heater core for the earlier WK-generation Grand Cherokee (2005-2010; shared with Commander XK). Correct core for the older half of this issue's year range — the WK2 core (68079484AA) does NOT fit these years.
existingFixParts.component: Heater core (2005-2010 WK)

existingFixParts.note: The plastic heater pipe/elbow assembly at the firewall is a common, DASH-OFF-NOT-REQUIRED leak point (hairline cracks in the molded elbows/quick-connects) — replace this before condemning the core if the leak is at the fittings. PN is engine/build-date specific: 68137715AA is the 2011 5.7L supply+re
existingFixParts.component: Heater supply/return hose & tube assembly (plastic firewall pipes/elbows) - WK2

existingFixParts.note: Mopar heater-tube O-ring for the WK/Commander XK (2005-2010). Cheap consumable that MUST be renewed whenever the heater tubes are disconnected from the core, otherwise the joint weeps after reassembly. WK2 cores generally ship with new seals — inspect and reuse/replace as supplied.
existingFixParts.component: Heater core inlet/outlet O-ring seals (2005-2010 WK)

existingFixParts.note: System must be refilled and bled after the repair. CRITICAL era/chemistry match: 2013-2021 use Mopar OAT 10yr/150k PURPLE (FCA MS-12106) — concentrate 68163848AA or premix 68163849AA. 2005-2012 use HOAT G-05 orange (MS-9769) — concentrate 68048953AB. OAT and HOAT gel if mixed — flush fully if switch
existingFixParts.component: Engine coolant / antifreeze (refill & bleed after repair)

existingFixParts.component: Heater supply/return hose & tube assembly (plastic firewall pipes/elbows) - WK2

existingFixParts.note: Mopar heater-tube O-ring for the WK/Commander XK (2005-2010). existingFixParts.note: THE core fix. NV247 requires this special low-viscosity hydraulic-tractor-type fluid (equiv. Mobil 424) — NOT ATF and NOT gear oil. existingFixParts.component: NV242 (Selec-Trac) transfer case fluid — for the full-time variant

entries.component: main and auxiliary batteries
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Test both the main and auxiliary batteries; replace the failed unit with the correct AGM specification (the auxiliary is a small dedicated battery, often near the air-box/fender).

existingFixParts.note: WK2 (2014-2021) 3.6L V6 and 5.7L HEMI use a vented Group 94R/H7 AGM main battery (~770-800 CCA). MUST be AGM and externally vented for ESS to work; a flooded wet-cell will fail prematurely and trip 'Stop/Start not available'. Mopar OEM PN BBAH7800AA is the H7/94R AGM unit (also superseded/cross-list
existingFixParts.component: Main AGM starting battery (BCI Group 94R / H7, AGM, ~800 CCA)

existingFixParts.note: Small dedicated AGM aux battery that powers electronics/keeps voltage stable during the ESS auto-restart; common early-failure item that produces 'battery charging'/'Stop-Start not ready' messages. Located on the passenger side near the air-box/fender area on WK2. Mopar PN 56029759AB is the OEM aux

existingFixParts.note: PRIMARY fix per resolution. Do NOT use ATF+4 - the ZF 8HP needs 8&9-Speed ATF. Sold per quart; a drain-and-fill takes ~7-9 qt. Pair with TCM software reflash (dealer/wiTECH, not a buyable part) + adaptive relearn first - that resolves most shift complaints with no hardware.
existingFixParts.component: ZF-approved 8-speed ATF (ZF Lifeguard 8 / Mopar 8 & 9 Speed ATF) - fluid for the spec'd fluid change

existingFixParts.note: Needed alongside the fluid for a proper service. Applies to 845RE (3.6L V6 / 5.7L V8 gas). For the 3.0L EcoDiesel (ZF 8HP70) use Mopar 68225344AA / ZF 1087.298.361 instead. Filter is bonded into the plastic pan - replace the whole pan.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan with integrated filter (filter is part of the pan on the ZF 8HP/845RE)

existingFixParts.note: Most OEM plastic pan-and-filter assemblies ship with the gasket; only order separately for a reusable-pan/filter-only service. Also budget the Torx pan bolts (Mopar 6510066AA x5, 6510065AA x15) if reusing isn't possible.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan gasket (if using a metal reusable pan / filter-only kit)

existingFixParts.note: Last-resort per resolution ('valve body inspection or replacement may be needed'). Year/engine-specific suffix varies (this PN spans ~2016-2018 845RE); confirm by VIN before ordering. Reman R8261622AD is markedly cheaper. Inspect/scan for solenoid faults before buying - reflash + relearn fixes most

existingFixParts.note: Use for early WK2 3.6 (also 14-20 GC 3.0L EcoDiesel). 5184498-series is the Grand Cherokee pump - do NOT use the Wrangler JK 68079412 pump. Replace thermostat at the same time; bleed cooling system after.
existingFixParts.component: Engine Water Pump (3.6L Pentastar, early WK2 2011-~2015 / 3.0L diesel)

existingFixParts.note: Later WK2 (Stop-Start/VVT) uses the 68311108 pump, not 5184498 - verify by year/VIN. Gates 44039 and US Motor Works US8160 are the popular aftermarket picks. Replace thermostat together and bleed the system.

entries.component: Front Brake Rotor (WK, 2005-2010) — pair
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Existing fixParts:0 must be reverified and keyed-merged.

existingFixParts.note: Per-rotor price; buy in pairs. 2005-2010 WK & 06-10 Commander XK. Coated (FZN) resists the corrosion that drives runout/warping. Replace both fronts together, do NOT just machine thin rotors.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Rotor (WK, 2005-2010) — pair

existingFixParts.note: Fits 05-10 Grand Cherokee WK & 06-10 Commander XK. Akebono ceramic (ACT1057) matches OE feel and reduces dust/pulsation recurrence. Pair with new rotors + clean hub face.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WK, 2005-2010)

existingFixParts.note: Sticking/seized slide pins are the root cause of uneven pad wear + heat-induced rotor pulsation. Replace bushings/boots and re-lube with high-temp silicone grease, or warping returns.
existingFixParts.component: Front Caliper Guide Pin / Bushing Kit (WK, 2005-2010)

existingFixParts.note: Per-rotor; same rotor for both Akebono and Teves WJ systems. OE 52098672 (a.k.a. 5018672) superseded by 1BP00064AA. Coated rotor (76793FZN) best fights the rust-runout warping cycle.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Rotor (WJ, 1999-2004) — pair

existingFixParts.note: WJ has TWO caliper systems — you MUST physically check the caliper (VIN won't tell you). Akebono = silver caliper, solid bracket. ACT748 is the OE-match ceramic.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WJ, Akebono caliper, built 5/11/2002 to end of WJ — silver caliper, solid bracket)

existingFixParts.note: Teves = black caliper, open-sided bracket, spring clip on outer pad. Wrong-system pads will not seat and will cause pulsation. Confirm caliper visually before ordering.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WJ, Continental Teves/TRW caliper, 1999 to 5/10/2002 — black caliper, open-sided bracket + spring c

existingFixParts.note: If a WJ caliper sticks, pads/rotor warp again fast. Service the pins/bushings or rebuild/replace the caliper. Akebono pin kit 5093184AA; if upgrading Teves-to-Akebono, caliper kit is 5093174AA.
existingFixParts.component: Front Caliper Slide/Pin Kit (WJ, Akebono) — sticking-caliper fix
aftermarketXref: Crown Automotive RT31036 (front brake/caliper kit, Akebono)

entries.component: regulator
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacement of the complete regulator, often with an updated aftermarket metal-reinforced unit

existingFixParts.note: Primary fix for glass-drop. Failure = plastic cable sled/trolley cracks where cable attaches, dropping glass into door. Replace the COMPLETE regulator-with-motor (Dorman 741-556) for a one-and-done fix; the metal-reinforced aftermarket units (TYC/A-Premium) are the 'updated' upgrade in the fix text.
existingFixParts.component: Front Power Window Regulator with Motor Assembly - Driver/Left (WJ front door, most common drop)

existingFixParts.note: Passenger-side counterpart, same failure mode (broken cable trolley). Dorman 741-557 is the complete metal-reinforced reg+motor assembly. Genuine Mopar (55363286AE) runs higher (~$120-200). Order by side - left/right regulators are NOT interchangeable.
existingFixParts.component: Front Power Window Regulator with Motor Assembly - Passenger/Right (WJ front door)

existingFixParts.note: Only needed if a REAR window dropped (rear doors use a different, shorter regulator than the fronts - do not substitute front parts). Same cable-sled failure pattern.
existingFixParts.component: Rear Power Window Regulator with Motor Assembly - Driver/Left (WJ rear door)

existingFixParts.note: Rear passenger counterpart. Verify the dropped glass is a REAR window before ordering - the four doors use four distinct part numbers on the WJ.
existingFixParts.component: Rear Power Window Regulator with Motor Assembly - Passenger/Right (WJ rear door)

existingFixParts.note: Fix for tick caused by collapsed/worn rocker (cam lobe slapping a seized roller). Use the latest -AH revision (full-floating center pin) — it cured the tick. existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for early TJ (2000-2001, same 4-terminal resistor as 1997-2001 Cherokee XJ). This card-type resistor is the exact part that loses low/medium fan speeds when its coils burn open; high still works because it bypasses the resistor. Mounts on the HVAC housing under the passenger side
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2000-2001 TJ, pre-2002 HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for the 2002-2006 TJ after the HVAC redesign (shared with 2002-2007 Liberty KJ). Different resistor than the 2000-2001 part. Same failure mode: fan drops lower speeds first, then works only on high. Verify model year before ordering since 2002 is the split point.
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2002-2006 TJ, redesigned HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: TSB/repair-kit companion part. 1999-2001 TJs are notorious for the resistor connector overheating and melting, so the documented fix commonly replaces the pigtail alongside the resistor. existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor Pigtail / Connector Repair Harness (2000-2006 TJ)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part: the documented fix notes a dragging blower motor draws excess current and re-cooks a new resistor, so many repairs replace both. This is the 2002-2006 twist-lock motor (shared with Liberty KJ). Only needed if measured current draw is high; otherwise resistor + pigtail alone.
existingFixParts.component: Heater/A-C Blower Motor with Wheel (2002-2006 TJ, only if motor is dragging/high current)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for early TJ (2000-2001, same 4-terminal resistor as 1997-2001 Cherokee XJ). This card-type resistor is the exact part that loses low/medium fan speeds when its coils burn open; high still works because it bypasses the resistor. Mounts on the HVAC housing under the passenger side
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2000-2001 TJ, pre-2002 HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for the 2002-2006 TJ after the HVAC redesign (shared with 2002-2007 Liberty KJ). Different resistor than the 2000-2001 part. Same failure mode: fan drops lower speeds first, then works only on high. Verify model year before ordering since 2002 is the split point.
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2002-2006 TJ, redesigned HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: TSB/repair-kit companion part. 1999-2001 TJs are notorious for the resistor connector overheating and melting, so the documented fix commonly replaces the pigtail alongside the resistor. Crown 5019941AA fits 97-06 TJ (and XJ) as an OEM-spec discontinued-harness replacement; Dorman 973-305 is the con
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor Pigtail / Connector Repair Harness (2000-2006 TJ)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part: the documented fix notes a dragging blower motor draws excess current and re-cooks a new resistor, so many repairs replace both. This is the 2002-2006 twist-lock motor (shared with Liberty KJ). Only needed if measured current draw is high; otherwise resistor + pigtail alone.
existingFixParts.component: Heater/A-C Blower Motor with Wheel (2002-2006 TJ, only if motor is dragging/high current)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part for the pre-2002 TJ, matching the 2000-2001 resistor (4864957) era. Replace only if current-draw test shows the motor is dragging. Aftermarket cross-refs are less thoroughly confirmed than the 5139720AA motor; the Mopar 04864952 number itself is a real TJ blower motor PN.
existingFixParts.component: Heater/A-C Blower Motor with Wheel (2000-2001 TJ, only if motor is dragging/high current)

existingFixParts.note: Confirm CARB vs Federal/EPA before buying (CA-legal Magnaflow/Walker cost more). TJ 4.0L runs a front cat AND a rear main cat — pinpoint which is failing; P0420 usually flags the downstream/main cat. Correct misfires/rich-run/oil burning first or the new cat re-fails. OEM 52059681 family applies to
existingFixParts.component: Catalytic Converter Assembly (4.0L I6 — converter & pipe; note TJ uses front cat + rear main cat, year-split below)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part — only replace if scope shows the downstream sensor is sluggish/non-switching. TJ 4.0L is notoriously picky: use NGK/NTK (factory OE) to avoid false re-triggers. Upstream is 56041212 (different part — do not swap).
existingFixParts.component: Downstream (post-cat) Oxygen Sensor — replace if 'lazy' and triggering P0420/P0432
aftermarketXref: NTK/NGK (OE supplier for Mopar — TJ is sensitive to non-NGK/
Bosch (some report TJ tolerance issues vs NTK)

entries.repairRoleEvidence: Clutch replacement required if worn.

existingFixParts.note: Primary fix. OEM 68273845AD (current rev) ~$230-$360; aftermarket LuK/Valeo/Sachs ~$180-$300; Centerforce II/Dual Friction ~$400-$700 is the off-road/towing upgrade the fix text suggests. CAUTION: do NOT use JK-era Centerforce kits (30500504/30500483) — those fit 07-18 JK only, not JL.

existingFixParts.note: Mopar 'Power Pack Unit Battery Kit' for 2018-2024 Jeep Wrangler JL, fits BOTH the 3.6L V6 and 2.0L turbo eTorque. This is the 48V battery/power-pack the FIX names as the most frequent culprit (forums: '99% of charging issues are the PPU, not the MGU'). MSRP ~$2,115; street ~$1,373-1,449. Hazmat ship
existingFixParts.component: 48V Power Pack Unit (PPU) Battery Kit — the most common charging-fault cause on eTorque Wranglers

existingFixParts.note: The MGU/BSG explicitly cited in the FIX. Mopar 'Belt Driven Starter Generator' for 2019-2024 with the 3.6L V6 24V VVT eTorque engine (the volume Wrangler eTorque powertrain). MUST be programmed/initialized with the factory scan tool after install or it will not function. ~$75 core charge. Cross-refs
existingFixParts.component: 48V Belt-Driven Starter Generator / Motor-Generator Unit (MGU/BSG) — 3.6L V6 eTorque

It supersedes to 05281667AD (2018-2025 listing). Kept exactly as cited per capture ru
existingFixParts.component: BSG lower belt tensioner — 2.0L turbo eTorque (the PN cited as 'belt/tensioner 05281667AC')

For the 2.0L turbo eTorque the corresponding BSG belt is 5281668AA — listed as the cross-ref so the right belt is picked by engine. existingFixParts.note: Primary fix for P0456 (small leak) and P0455/P0457 when cap + smoke-test are clean. Snaps onto the charcoal canister, driver side just ahead of the rear axle. Forum consensus on the JK: aftermarket Dorman/SMP units (~$38) sometimes fail to clear P0456 due to calibration/quality — genuine Mopar 04861
existingFixParts.component: EVAP System Integrity Module (ESIM / Leak Detection Pump)

existingFixParts.note: The cheapest first fix — do this before the ESIM, especially for P0457 or a 'gascap' dash message. Fits 2003-2018 TJ/JK. Confirm it clicks shut and the seal isn't cracked. OEM Mopar cap is recommended over generic caps, which sometimes re-trigger the code.

entries.component: fuel tank module
entries.repairRoleEvidence: The proper fix is replacement of the fuel tank module or tank assembly components specified by the recall or service procedure, not just changing the gas cap.

existingFixParts.note: THE fix part: the inlet check valve (ICV) is molded into the tank inlet and is NOT sold separately (Chrysler TSB 14-001-09 Rev. A). 05-06 TJ/LJ were excluded from the 07+ warranty extension, so owners self-pay. Genuine Mopar tank ~$400-550; Spectra CR16A ~$180-260. Buy the tank, not just a gas cap.

entries.component: spark plugs
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacement of the coil rail assembly and spark plugs is the typical fix
entries.condition: If the rail is weak or cracked,

existingFixParts.note: Mopar 56041476AB supersedes 56041476AA — order the AB. Aftermarket (SMP/Spectra/Delphi) ~$35-71; genuine Mopar ~$130-180. Confirm misfire isn't injectors/compression first. Keep valve-cover area dry (oil/coolant kills the rail).
existingFixParts.component: Ignition Coil Rail / Coil Pack Assembly (4.0L I6 waste-spark DIS)

existingFixParts.note: Factory-correct plugs matter — coil rail is waste-spark (each coil fires 2 plugs). Use copper RC12LYC/ZFR5N gapped 0.035"; apply dielectric grease to boots. Avoid platinum/iridium mismatches that aggravate DIS misfires.

entries.component: rear output shaft seal
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the rear output shaft seal (National/SKF 18662 or equivalent) after cleaning/inspecting the yoke and tail bushing

existingFixParts.note: THE primary basic-fix part for 97-06 TJ. Mopar/Crown OE 4798117 (~2.76" OD x 1.83" ID) fits NP231 and NP242 rear output slip-yoke. NOTE: the issue text lists 'National/SKF 18662' for the basic fix — that is WRONG; 18662 is the SYE fixed-yoke seal (see separate line). Tape over the retainer-clip groo
existingFixParts.component: Rear output shaft seal — TJ (1997-2006), NP231/NP242

existingFixParts.note: Era-correct basic-fix seal for the 1994-95 YJ (and 87-95 YJ / 87-95 XJ). Different part from the TJ seal — the 4798117 supersedes for 96+ vehicles. Use this one for the pre-TJ years in the 1994-2006 span.
existingFixParts.component: Rear output shaft seal — YJ (1994-1995), NP231

existingFixParts.note: This is the seal the issue text mis-labeled as the 'basic' seal. It fits the SMALLER fixed yoke of an SYE conversion (~1.937" ID x 2.750" OD) — only used if you install an SYE kit, NOT for a stock slip-yoke reseal. Fits TeraFlex / Advance Adapters / JB Conversions / Rugged Ridge SYE yokes on NP231/2
existingFixParts.component: SYE fixed-yoke output seal (Slip-Yoke Eliminator path)

existingFixParts.note: Housing-side oil seal for the Rugged Ridge/Omix NP231 SYE housing (18676.60). Era-correct for 87-06 YJ/TJ NP231 SYE conversions. Only relevant on the SYE-upgrade path, paired with the 18662 yoke seal.
existingFixParts.component: SYE tail-housing oil seal (Rugged Ridge/Omix)

existingFixParts.note: Full fixed-yoke conversion for NP231 in YJ/TJ. Chosen when the tail bushing is worn or a lift causes driveline vibration. Crown RT24005 verified as an NP231 SYE kit. REQUIRES a matching CV rear driveshaft (below).
existingFixParts.component: Slip-Yoke Eliminator (SYE) kit (optional upgrade for worn tail bushing / lift vibration)

entries.component: opda
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacing the OPDA with an updated unit and inspecting the cam gear for abnormal wear before reinstalling

existingFixParts.note: Primary fix. Factory unit starves the upper bronze bushing (seal cuts off oil) causing squeal + cam gear wear. Crown's 53010624AC fixes the lube path - prefer it over a plain reman. Verify cam gear wear before reinstall; 2005-2006 requires a cam/crank relearn after install.
existingFixParts.component: OPDA (Oil Pump Drive Assembly / camshaft synchronizer) for 4.0L I6

existingFixParts.note: Secondary. The Crown OPDA usually ships with a sensor - use the sensor matched to the OPDA brand for reliable sync (mixing brands causes no-start/sync faults). OEM 5149034AA is largely discontinued; perform cam/crank relearn after any sensor swap.
existingFixParts.component: Camshaft Position Sensor (cam sync sensor, mounts in the OPDA)

entries.component: master switch
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replace the master switch (Mopar 68290764AE for 2018+
entries.condition: If all windows die together, suspect the driver's master switch — pop the switch panel with a trim tool, inspect for corrosion/water, clean contacts with electrical cleaner, or

existingFixParts.note: Correct master switch for the EARLY JK (2007-2010). If all windows die together, this is the prime suspect (water/carbon at contacts). NOTE: the FIX text's cited PN 68290764AE is the WRONG ERA — that is the JL-generation (2018+ JL) switch and does NOT fit a 2007-2018 JK; verified it fits only 2018-2
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2007-2010 JK, 4-door/2-door dash-mounted)

existingFixParts.note: Correct master switch for the LATER 4-door JK (2011-2018). Supersession 68057595AC -> 68156217AA -> AB -> AC. This is the era-correct replacement for the (incorrectly cited) 68290764AE. Replace if all windows quit / wrong-window operation / water intrusion at contacts.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK Unlimited 4-door)

existingFixParts.note: Separate 2-door JK (2011-2018) master switch — distinct PN from the 4-door 68156217AC. Confirmed on Mopar eStore as 2011-2018 fitment. Use this for 2-door JKs; the 4-door PN will not match the button layout.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK 2-door)

existingFixParts.note: Front LEFT (driver) window regulator w/ 2-pin motor, fits 07-18 JK with power windows. Replace when the motor whirs/grinds but glass won't move (broken plastic guides/clips). OEM ~$129 (MSRP $191); quality aftermarket assemblies ~$45-80. 68014953AA is the regulator-with-motor variant often listed in
existingFixParts.component: Front driver-side power window regulator with motor (front left)

existingFixParts.note: Front RIGHT (passenger) regulator counterpart for 07-18 JK, included because a single-window-dead fault can be on either side; the driver side is 68014949AA. Mopar eStore lists 68018024AA as the right front 2007-2018 regulator.
existingFixParts.component: Front passenger-side power window regulator with motor (front right) — if the right window is the failed one

existingFixParts.note: Correct master switch for the EARLY JK (2007-2010). If all windows die together, this is the prime suspect (water/carbon at contacts). NOTE: the FIX text's cited PN 68290764AE is the WRONG ERA — that is the JL-generation (2018+ JL) switch and does NOT fit a 2007-2018 JK; verified it fits only 2018-2
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2007-2010 JK, 4-door/2-door dash-mounted)

existingFixParts.note: Correct master switch for the LATER 4-door JK (2011-2018). Supersession 68057595AC -> 68156217AA -> AB -> AC. This is the era-correct replacement for the (incorrectly cited) 68290764AE. Replace if all windows quit / wrong-window operation / water intrusion at contacts.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK Unlimited 4-door)

existingFixParts.note: Separate 2-door JK (2011-2018) master switch — distinct PN from the 4-door 68156217AC. Confirmed on Mopar eStore as 2011-2018 fitment. Use this for 2-door JKs; the 4-door PN will not match the button layout.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK 2-door)

existingFixParts.note: Front LEFT (driver) window regulator w/ 2-pin motor, fits 07-18 JK with power windows. Replace when the motor whirs/grinds but glass won't move (broken plastic guides/clips). OEM ~$129 (MSRP $191); quality aftermarket assemblies ~$45-80. 68014953AA is the regulator-with-motor variant often listed in
existingFixParts.component: Front driver-side power window regulator with motor (front left)

existingFixParts.note: Front RIGHT (passenger) regulator counterpart for 07-18 JK, included because a single-window-dead fault can be on either side; the driver side is 68014949AA. Mopar eStore lists 68018024AA as the right front 2007-2018 regulator.
existingFixParts.component: Front passenger-side power window regulator with motor (front right) — if the right window is the failed one

existingFixParts.note: QD Electronic/contact cleaner — the FIX explicitly says clean contacts with electrical cleaner. Plastic-safe, non-conductive, no-residue quick-dry; correct chemistry for switch/connector contacts. Not vehicle-specific (it is a consumable), so no era concern.
existingFixParts.component: Electrical/contact cleaner for cleaning corroded switch contacts (consumable, documented in FIX)

entries.component: radiator
entries.repairRoleEvidence: The standard repair is radiator replacement, usually along with fresh coolant, cap inspection, and replacement of aged hoses if needed.

existingFixParts.note: TJ end-tank radiators are plastic-tank/aluminum-core and crack at the seam — replacement is the fix. THIS is the MANUAL-trans core (no trans cooler). OEM Mopar 55037652AA was DISCONTINUED late Oct 2022, so most buyers now go aftermarket. Spectra CU2101 (~$120-165) is the standard 1-row OE-style repl
existingFixParts.component: Radiator — 4.0L I6 (or 2.4L/2.5L I4) with MANUAL transmission (no integrated trans-oil cooler)

existingFixParts.note: Same cracking-end-tank failure; this is the AUTOMATIC-trans core — it has the built-in transmission-oil cooler with the two trans-line fittings, so it is NOT interchangeable with the manual 55037652AA core. OEM Mopar 55037653AB; aftermarket TYC 2102 is the direct replacement. Many complete aftermark
existingFixParts.component: Radiator — 4.0L I6 (or 2.4L/2.5L I4) with AUTOMATIC transmission (integrated trans-oil cooler ports)
aftermarketXref: Spectra Premium CU2101 (universal AT/MT complete radiator)

existingFixParts.note: A worn/over-pressurizing cap accelerates end-tank cracking, so the standard repair replaces it with the radiator. TJ cooling system runs a 16 psi cap — Stant 10230 is the common $8-12 cross-ref. Cheap insurance; do it whenever the radiator is replaced.

existingFixParts.note: CRITICAL for 3.6L Pentastar (JK 2012-2018, JL early). On the Pentastar there is NO cut 'upper oil pan gasket' — the structural aluminum upper oil pan AND the lower pan are both sealed to the block with Mopar gray ThreeBond RTV. Factory service procedure: 2-3mm bead on the flange plus the timing-cove
existingFixParts.component: Mopar Gray ThreeBond Engine RTV Sealant (3.6L Pentastar upper/lower oil pan seal — JK 2012-2018)

existingFixParts.note: Later JL-generation 3.6L (and 2021+) moved to an actual molded rubber oil pan gasket on the lower pan; Mopar 68522534AA is cataloged for the 3.6L V6 24V VVT, with 68507898AA listed for 2021-2026 Wrangler. Fel-Pro OS30835 is the common aftermarket one-piece lower-pan carrier gasket covering 2012-2024

entries.component: mopar corning gorilla glass
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacement is the only fix once cracked. Owners report better durability from the Mopar Corning Gorilla Glass windshield upgrade.

existingFixParts.note: THE fix. Match the BASE config (no camera/heat/antenna). PN superseded AA->AB->AC; order current AC. Not a defect cure — JL glass is just thin; this is the durability upgrade owners report. Check comp/glass insurance first; pair with a windshield protection film as cheaper mitigation.
existingFixParts.component: Mopar Corning Gorilla Glass windshield upgrade (base, no options) — 2018-2023 Jeep Wrangler JL / 2020-2023 Gladiator JT
aftermarketXref: No true aftermarket cross-ref — Gorilla Glass is a Mopar/Cor

existingFixParts.note: Use ONLY if the JL has the in-glass radio antenna. Installing the wrong config can break antenna function. Verify against the original glass's features before ordering.
